subject: Renewal + scope confirmation: LLM labeling & prompt evals (Q2)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@labelforge.ai>, Kevin Brooks <kevin@keystone-consult.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RFP follow-up: renewal + expanded prompt-eval scope

Hi Sara / Kevin,

Following up on our conversation last week — thanks again for the sample eval results. We are preparing the Q2 contractor slate and want to confirm pricing and SLAs for two line items: (1) ongoing labeling for 250k prompt-response pairs (mix of multi-turn chat + instruction), and (2) a 4-week focused prompt-eval program (A/B prompt perturbation, metric definitions, exemplar-driven evaluation).

Can you send updated scope-of-work + firm pricing for 3 options: standard turnaround (10 business days), expedited (5 business days), and a continuous throughput model (steady-state weekly deliverables + retention for 6 months)? We also need SOC 2 evidence and a sample data handling attestation for our security team.

Let us know lead times for onboarding and whether you can commit to our data retention policy (30 days raw, 1 year aggregated).

Thanks — Im looping in Tessa and Avery from Product and Procurement.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal_note_q2_needs.txt (text)
From: Sara Patel <sara@labelforge.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up: renewal + expanded prompt-eval scope

Hi Marissa — great to hear from you. Appreciated the call. Quick summary and next steps below.

Summary: We can cover both line items. Attached is Proposal_v3 (PDF) with fixed-price options and an SOW addendum for the prompt-eval sprint.

Key points: 
- Labeling: 250k pairs: Standard: $145,000 (10 bd); Expedited: $185,000 (5 bd); Continuous weekly: $7,500/week (min 12 weeks)
- Prompt-eval sprint: $38,000 (4 weeks) includes metric design, 2k human evals, bias checks, and a deliverable deck with recommended prompts & thresholds
- Security: We are SOC 2 Type II in progress; can provide interim attestation + data handling attestation (PII redaction + ephemeral VM policy)
- Onboarding: 2-week ramp for tooling + test batch

Attachment: labelforge_proposal_v3.pdf (pdf)

Happy to set a call with our delivery lead to walk the SOW.

Best,
Sara Patel
Head of Partnerships, LabelForge
From: Kevin Brooks <kevin@keystone-consult.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up: renewal + expanded prompt-eval scope

Marissa / Tessa — thanks for including us. I know you are evaluating a pure-label vendor + a consulting partner to run the prompt-eval program end-to-end. Keystone can provide: evaluation design, rubric standardization, inter-rater reliability checks, and a gating review for production rollout. 

We propose a Statement of Work (attached) at $52,000 for the 4-week engagement if we are the delivery owner. We can also act as a quality gate on LabelForge deliverables for an hourly QA rate ($180/hr).

Attachment: keystone_statement_of_work.docx (docx)

If useful, we can provide a short 'trial sprint' — 200 evals executed in 5 business days for $3,600 so you can compare quality before committing.

-Kevin
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: recommendation for labeling + evals (confidential)

Team — quick internal read. I reviewed both proposals and ran the trial sprint code sample that LabelForge provided. High-level thoughts:

- LabelForge: cost-effective for bulk labeling; tooling integrates with our ingestion flow; sample batch passed spot checks for quality (inter-rater agreement ~0.78).
- Keystone: stronger on rubric design and reliability processes; good for building the eval framework and sign-off for production.

Recommendation: Hybrid approach — contract LabelForge for the 250k labeling (continuous weekly model at $7.5k/week) and engage Keystone for the 4-week prompt-eval program + a 1-week QA gate at the end. This splits responsibilities and keeps unit cost predictable.

Open items for Procurement (Vivek / Avery):
- Confirm acceptable payment terms (Net 30 vs Net 45) and whether we can add SLAs/credits for missed deliverables.
- Confirm vendor SOC 2 timeline and whether interim attestation suffices.

If Procurement signs off, Ill reply to vendors with scope and request final SOWs and PO routing.

Thanks,
Tessa
Senior Product Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@labelforge.ai>, Kevin Brooks <kevin@keystone-consult.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Decision: hybrid engagement for Q2 labeling + evals

Hi Sara / Kevin — thanks for the quick turnaround and the proposals. After reviewing internally wed like to move forward with the hybrid plan Tessa proposed:

1) LabelForge — continuous weekly labeling: start April 1, 2026; weekly cadence at $7,500/week; 2-week onboarding, 30-day raw data retention as requested. Please send final SOW and a sample data handling attestation that matches our policy.

2) Keystone — prompt-eval sprint: start March 15, 2026; 4-week engagement per the SOW at $52,000. Wed also like Keystone to run a 1-week QA gating run immediately after the sprint to validate LabelForge outputs ($6,480 for the gate if hourly QA is used).

Procurement (Avery / Vivek) — please confirm payment terms and PO routing. Ill attach the internal approval binder once Procurement confirms.

Next steps for vendors: please send final SOWs and an invoice template. Well aim to issue a PO by 2/26 if terms are accepted.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
